messages:
olivia: Heads-up — planning a shadow publish of the Python + TS SDK to cohort B during tonight's quiet window (02:00 UTC). Shadow means we publish under a cohort tag but DO NOT flip the `latest` dist-tag. release-bot will post canary statuses. Only QA smoke expected. :hourglass:

sam: +1. Confirming: no dist-tag flip, no deprecation notes, pinned beta metadata only? Want to avoid any automated GA promotion.

chandra: Correct. We'll set metadata `x-release-cohort: B-shadow` and `version` will be semver+build. No changelog surfaced yet.

mike: Who's on monitor? I'll be on pager standby for the 02:00-03:00 UTC window. @chandra want you on telemetry/rollout checks.

olivia: @mike @chandra yep — plan: 02:00 start, 02:05 canary smoke (install + basic import + simple generation), 02:10 cohort traffic shadowed to telemetry. Abort criteria listed below.

sam: What are abort/rollback thresholds? Need concrete numbers for on-call.

olivia: Abort if any of the following within first 30m:
- install failures >5% across cohort (pip/npm errors)
- runtime exceptions >1% on inference endpoints (traceback count)
- CI smoke fails (import/generate)
If abort -> immediately yank shadow tag and mark packages `yanked` in internal index, notify infra to block further cohort shadow traffic.

release-bot: publish-cohort-started: cohort=B-shadow, packages=[redwood-sdk-py, redwood-sdk-ts], initiator=olivia

olivia: Publish commands for reference:
```
# python (local build)
python -m build
python -m twine upload --repository-url https://pypi.internal.example/simple dist/* --comment "cohort=B-shadow"

# typescript
npm publish --tag cohort-b-shadow --access public
```

chandra: I'll watch telemetry: install-success, import-success, latency/errrate. I'll post quick snapshots to this thread at +05m and +20m.

mike: If we hit abort, who executes the yank? @sam or @olivia?

sam: I'll yank the npm tag and coordinate with infra to mark the wheel/egg as yanked. For PyPI we'll push a `yanked` property in our internal index and remove the cohort tag.

release-bot: canary-status: redwood-sdk-py (canary): build OK, install smoke OK, import smoke OK. redwood-sdk-ts (canary): publish OK, minimal smoke OK.

olivia: Good. After +20m, if metrics stable, we'll leave shadow published for 24h for additional telemetry but still no dist-tag promotion. Only if we decide to GA later will we follow a separate promotion run with notes and deprecation timeline.

chandra: +05m snapshot: installs 0.6% failures (mostly transient network), import success 99.8%, no runtime exceptions in sample harness.

sam: +10m check: npm download rate normal, no sign of unusual dependency resolution.

mike: Standing by. If anyone needs me to trigger abort, ping with "ABORT COHORT B" and I'll take action. :thumbsup:

release-bot: publish-complete: cohort=B-shadow, timestamp=02:07 UTC, artifacts=uploaded

olivia: Thanks team — I'll follow up with a short internal note after the 24h observation. If we stay green, next step is a scheduled promotion run in two weeks with proper changelog and deprecation messaging for the old major.

chandra: Noted. Will paste a telemetry summary here after 24h.

sam: Added manual checklist to the release doc: publish, smoke, observe 30m, observe 24h, decide promotion. Link: https://go/release/roadmap-cohort-b-shadow (internal).

mike: Leaving a quick ops note: if we need emergency rollback after 24h and the package was pulled into any internal caches, contact CDN ops to purge; otherwise yanking tag alone can be insufficient.

olivia: Copy. All set for 02:00 UTC. See you in the thread for realtime updates. :rocket:
